title: From pre-mRNA to mature mRNA
caption: In eukaryotes the first transcript is processed before it leaves the nucleus: a cap protects the 5′ end, a poly-A tail stabilises the 3′ end, and the spliceosome removes the introns and joins the exons.
alt: Five boxes in order: pre-mRNA, 5′ cap, poly-A tail, splicing and mature mRNA.
description: Pre-mRNA: exons and introns, made in the nucleus.
5′ cap: a modified guanine added to the 5′ end.
Poly-A tail: many adenines added to the 3′ end.
Splicing: the spliceosome removes the introns and joins the exons.
Mature mRNA: leaves through the nuclear pores for translation.
